scenes.heading: Building a portfolio without an agency history yet

sents.d: Building a portfolio without an agency history yet
Case studies from any account you've grown — even your own — count as proof of skill.

Managing your own personal or business account and documenting real growth (follower count, engagement rate, or a specific campaign's results) creates a legitimate case study even before you have paying clients.

scenes.heading: Trade a pilot for a case study

sents.d: Offering a discounted or limited pilot engagement to a first client in exchange for a detailed case study and testimonial is a common way agencies build their first proof points.

A portfolio for this field works best showing results and strategy, not just pretty screenshots — a short before/after with actual metrics (engagement rate, follower growth, leads generated) is far more convincing to potential clients than aesthetics alone.

take: Build proof with your own account and a first pilot client.
